meta.description: Decentraland DAO governance votes (frozen export, 2023-04-30). 53,533 votes by 4,133 voters on 1,816 proposals over 705 days. Bipartite, so it is projected onto voters: two voters are linked when they voted on the same proposal in the window.
meta.graph_edges_are: two voters who voted on the same proposal in the window
meta.edge_attributes_available: Choice # (yes/no/abstain), Vote Weight and six voting-power columns (Total VP, MANA, LAND, NAMES, DELEGATED, Rental); none is used
meta.edge_attributes_note: The real-data experiments use only temporal interaction topology. Dataset-specific edge weights and signs are not used by the existing TGAP transformations or metrics.

preprocessing.projection: one-mode, onto voters (bipartite rejected: it makes bridge width identical to edge count)
preprocessing.node_selection: top 100 voters by vote count, ranked over 4630 selection-period votes
preprocessing.unused_fields_note: Choice #, Vote Weight and the VP columns are not used: no current TGAP metric or transformation reads edge weights
preprocessing.partition_source: greedy modularity on the selection-period co-voting graph only, then frozen
preprocessing.cohesion_note: inactive voters appear as isolated nodes, so snapshots are disconnected and algebraic connectivity is 0; cohesion is not a target
